# units/tib

> n tib: tebibytes: 1024 gib, as bytes.

truck [units](../units.md) · [source](../../../registry/units/tib.pkg)

```
print 1 tib  // 1099511627776
```

Binds tighter than any operator, so `2 * 3 tib` is `2 * (3 tib)`.
See [units](../units.md).

## Syntax

Kind: `postfix`, precedence 90, left-associative

```
{n: expr int} tib -> int
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `n` | expression | `int` |

Produces: `int`
